annotations.text:
Merged, not separate.

Same teachers, same login, same Django project, same launcher. A second site would mean a second password and a second thing to keep running for a non-technical user.

What keeps the two jobs from blurring is the masthead: Item bank and Diagnostics are departments, and the rule under them changes to the pages of whichever one you are in.

Order I would build it:

1. Papers + preview + download (needs diagnostics/export.py, the Examiner doc, the ZIP)
2. Issue register + generation window + per-teacher grades

One refactor is unavoidable in step 1: the .docx building currently sits inside the render_paper command, where a view cannot reach it.

Shown in staff view, with answers in the margin column. A teacher without staff rights sees the same page with that column blank — the key travels in the downloaded pack instead, which is what they administer from.
TEACHER01-04 are stand-ins. No teacher is assigned to a grade yet and no pack has ever been downloaded, so the live register is empty until someone is assigned in the Django admin.
